DevOps / Platform Engineer
Company: GridStack is a cloud-native infrastructure company (Series A, 90 employees) providing managed Kubernetes and observability solutions to engineering teams, headquartered in Denver, CO.

Location: Denver, CO or Remote (US)
Compensation: $140,000 - $175,000 + equity

About the Role:
We are hiring a DevOps / Platform Engineer to build and maintain the internal platform that enables our 60+ product engineers to ship safely and quickly. You will own our Kubernetes-based deployment infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability stack, while partnering closely with engineering teams to improve developer experience.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and operate multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS) supporting production workloads
- Own and improve CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD for continuous deployment
- Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform across multiple AWS accounts and environments
- Build and maintain observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry) and on-call runbooks
- Develop internal developer platform (IDP) tooling to reduce toil and improve deployment velocity
- Respond to infrastructure incidents, lead post-mortems, and drive reliability improvements

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering role (required)
- Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (cluster administration, networking, RBAC) (required)
- Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code (required)
- Experience with AWS services: EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC (required)
- Solid CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent (required)
- Scripting proficiency in Python or Bash for automation (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience with GitOps workflows using ArgoCD or Flux
- Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd)
- Exposure to security hardening practices for cloud environments (CIS benchmarks, pod security policies)
- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer)
- Experience with FinOps or cloud cost optimization
